extra_vocab.en: a place where planes take off and land
extra_vocab.note: 出差、接機、航班變更是多益最常見的情境，常和 flight、terminal、gate 一起出現。口語與公告裡都很常用，是必備的基本字。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「在機場」用 at the airport，「去機場」用 to the airport，「抵達機場」用 arrive at the airport，不說 arrive to。

example.en: Several airports in the region closed because of heavy snow.
example.zh: 該地區有幾個機場因大雪而關閉。

example.en: Please book the airport shuttle before you leave the hotel.
example.zh: 離開飯店前請先預約機場接駁車。

example.en: Airport security checks every bag, so please allow extra time.
example.zh: 機場安檢會檢查每件行李，所以請預留多一點時間。

example.en: Our driver will pick you up at the airport on Monday.
example.zh: 我們的司機星期一會到機場接你。

example.en: The airport terminal has a quiet room for business travelers.
example.zh: 機場航廈有一間給商務旅客使用的安靜休息室。

examples.en: I will meet you at the airport at seven tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 我明天早上七點在機場和你碰面。

examples.en: Please arrive at the airport two hours before your flight departs.
examples.zh: 請在航班起飛前兩小時抵達機場。

examples.en: The client's flight lands at noon, so we will start the meeting late.
examples.zh: 客戶的班機中午才降落，所以我們會晚一點開會。

examples.en: The hotel offers a free ride to the airport every hour.
examples.zh: 飯店每小時提供一班免費前往機場的接送。

confusable.diff: airline 是「航空公司」，airport 是「機場」這個地點。

example.en: Which airline are you flying with to Tokyo next week?
example.zh: 你下週搭哪一家航空公司的班機去東京？

example.en: Our flight leaves from Terminal Two, not Terminal One.
example.zh: 我們的班機從第二航廈出發，不是第一航廈。

example.en: Passengers should go to gate twelve for boarding.
example.zh: 乘客請前往十二號登機門登機。

example.en: Please collect your baggage at the carousel after landing.
example.zh: 降落後請到行李轉盤領取您的行李。

extra_vocab.en: a body reaction to food, dust, or other things that makes you feel sick
extra_vocab.note: 餐廳、公司聚餐與活動餐點中，常會詢問客人有沒有 food allergy。藥品與食品標示的情境也常出現這個字。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「對…過敏」用 have an allergy to + 物質，介系詞用 to；allergy 是可數名詞，複數是 allergies。

example.en: Employees with serious allergies should tell the safety manager.
example.zh: 有嚴重過敏的員工應告知安全主管。

example.en: The menu shows which dishes are safe for guests with a food allergy.
example.zh: 菜單上標示哪些菜色適合有食物過敏的客人。

example.en: He has an allergy to nuts, so he skipped the dessert.
example.zh: 他對堅果過敏，所以沒吃甜點。

example.en: Her seasonal allergy gets worse every spring, so she works from home.
example.zh: 她的季節性過敏每年春天都更嚴重，所以她在家工作。

example.en: Allergy medicine is available at the pharmacy next to the office.
example.zh: 辦公室隔壁的藥局有賣過敏藥。

examples.en: Please let the waiter know if you have an allergy.
examples.zh: 如果您有過敏，請告訴服務生。

examples.en: Please tell the organizer about any allergy before the lunch meeting.
examples.zh: 午餐會議前，請告知主辦人任何過敏狀況。

examples.en: The hotel kitchen can prepare a special meal for guests with an allergy.
examples.zh: 飯店廚房可以為有過敏的客人準備特別餐點。

confusable.diff: allergy 是身體對特定物質的過敏反應；illness 是一般的生病。

example.en: She missed the meeting because of an illness, not an allergy.
example.zh: 她缺席會議是因為生病，不是因為過敏。

example.en: A runny nose is a common symptom of an allergy.
example.zh: 流鼻水是過敏的常見症狀。

example.en: Every ingredient is listed on the back of the package.
example.zh: 每一項成分都列在包裝背面。

example.en: Please keep your medicine in your carry-on bag during the flight.
example.zh: 飛行期間請把您的藥放在隨身行李中。

derived.link: allergy 的 y 換成 -ic，變成形容詞「過敏的」，像 economy → economic；常用 be allergic to + 物質

extra_vocab.en: a person who does something for fun, not as a job
extra_vocab.note: 常見於比賽、活動與廣告情境，例如 amateur photographer（業餘攝影師）。與 professional 相對；當形容詞用有時帶有「不夠專業」的負面語氣。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: amateur 的第一個音是母音，單數名詞前用 an（an amateur）；當形容詞時放在名詞前面，如 an amateur photographer。

example.en: The league welcomes amateurs of all ages to join the tournament.
example.zh: 聯賽歡迎各年齡層的業餘愛好者參加錦標賽。

example.en: An amateur photographer took the winning picture for our magazine.
example.zh: 一位業餘攝影師拍下了我們雜誌的得獎照片。

example.en: Amateur athletes may join the company running event next month.
example.zh: 業餘運動員可以參加下個月的公司路跑活動。

example.en: Our team still plays at the amateur level, but it is improving.
example.zh: 我們的球隊仍在業餘程度，但正在進步。

examples.en: The contest is open to anyone, even an amateur with no training.
examples.zh: 比賽開放給任何人，即使是沒受過訓練的業餘者。

examples.en: The amateur video was cheap to make, but it went viral.
examples.zh: 那支業餘影片製作成本很低，卻在網路上爆紅。

examples.en: He is an amateur chef, but his dishes impress our clients.
examples.zh: 他是業餘廚師，但他的料理讓我們的客戶印象深刻。

examples.en: The report looked amateur, so the manager asked us to redo it.
examples.zh: 那份報告看起來不夠專業，所以經理要我們重做。

similar.diff: beginner 強調「剛開始學、經驗少」；amateur 強調「不以此為職業」，但可能已經很有經驗。

example.en: The course is designed for beginners who have never used the software.
example.zh: 這門課是為從沒用過這套軟體的初學者設計的。

example.en: We hired a professional designer to update our logo.
example.zh: 我們請了一位專業設計師來更新公司標誌。

example.en: Our tax expert will answer your questions after the talk.
example.zh: 我們的稅務專家會在演講後回答您的問題。

example.en: Photography started as a hobby, but now it is her job.
example.zh: 攝影一開始只是嗜好，但現在成了她的工作。

derived.zh: 外行的、不夠專業的（貶義）
derived.link: amateur + -ish，「有…樣子的」，像 childish；指做得像外行人，語氣偏負面

example.en: She is an amateur who paints landscapes on weekends.
example.zh: 她是個週末畫風景畫的業餘畫家。

example.en: The amateur theater group will perform at the town festival.
example.zh: 這個業餘劇團將在鎮上的慶典中演出。

senses.en: someone who does an activity for pleasure, not for pay
senses.distinguish: 中性語氣，常和 professional 對比。

example.en: As an amateur, he plays golf only on Sunday afternoons.
example.zh: 身為業餘愛好者，他只在星期天下午打高爾夫。

senses.en: a person who is not skilled at something
senses.distinguish: 帶批評語氣，常出現在 only an amateur 這類說法中。

example.en: Only an amateur would send a contract without checking it.
example.zh: 只有外行人才會沒檢查就寄出合約。

extra_vocab.en: a person who reads news or information on radio, TV, or at an event
extra_vocab.note: 多益常出現在廣播、機場或車站公告與活動介紹的情境中。announcer 是「做播報的人」，播報的內容則叫 announcement。

example.en: The station hired two new announcers for the evening news.
example.zh: 電台為晚間新聞聘請了兩位新的播報員。

example.en: She worked as a radio announcer before joining our marketing team.
example.zh: 她加入我們的行銷團隊之前，是一名電台播音員。

example.en: The sports announcer described every goal with great energy.
example.zh: 體育播報員以十足的活力描述每一個進球。

example.en: A TV announcer will read our company's new advertisement.
example.zh: 一位電視播報員將唸出我們公司的新廣告詞。

examples.en: The radio announcer read the traffic report every morning.
examples.zh: 廣播員每天早上都會播報路況。

examples.en: The announcer said our flight to Boston is now boarding.
examples.zh: 廣播員說我們飛往波士頓的班機現在開始登機。

examples.en: A famous announcer will introduce each speaker at the conference.
examples.zh: 一位知名的司儀將在研討會上介紹每位講者。

examples.en: The announcer thanked the sponsors before the game began.
examples.zh: 比賽開始前，播報員感謝了贊助商。

confusable.diff: announcer 是「播報的人」，announcement 是「公告、通知的內容」。

example.en: Please read the announcement on the board before the meeting.
example.zh: 會議前請先閱讀公布欄上的公告。

similar.diff: host 負責主持整個節目或活動；announcer 主要負責播報訊息或介紹來賓。

example.en: The host welcomed guests and kept the show running smoothly.
example.zh: 主持人歡迎來賓，並讓節目順利進行。

example.en: The host of the event thanked everyone for coming.
example.zh: 活動主持人感謝大家的蒞臨。

example.en: The first speaker will talk about sales results.
example.zh: 第一位講者將談銷售成果。

example.en: A reporter asked the CEO about the new product.
example.zh: 一位記者向執行長詢問新產品的事。

derived.link: 基本動詞「宣布」；加 -er 就變成做這件事的人，像 teach → teacher
announce + -ment，動作的結果變成名詞，像 pay → payment、agree → agreement
un-（不）+ announce + -ed，「沒有事先宣布的」，像 unlimited

extra_vocab.zh: 無論如何；不管怎樣；話說回來
extra_vocab.en: in any case; no matter what
extra_vocab.note: 偏口語，常用在對話裡表示「不管怎樣」或「回到正題」。多益聽力的對話中很常聽到，書面正式文件較少用。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: anyhow 偏口語；放句首時後面要加逗號。正式信件或報告建議改用 in any case 或 nevertheless。

example.en: Sorry you cannot join us. Thanks anyhow, and see you next time.
example.zh: 很遺憾你不能加入我們。還是謝謝你，下次見。

example.en: Not everyone replied, but we will go ahead anyhow.
example.zh: 不是每個人都回覆了，但我們還是會繼續進行。

example.en: Anyhow, as I was saying, sales rose in the second quarter.
example.zh: 總之，就像我剛才說的，第二季的銷售成長了。

examples.en: Anyhow, let's go back to the budget discussion.
examples.zh: 話說回來，我們回到預算的討論吧。

examples.en: The price is high, but we will buy it anyhow.
examples.zh: 價格很高，但我們還是會買。

examples.en: I already sent the file, but please check it again anyhow.
examples.zh: 我已經寄出檔案了，但還是請你再確認一次。

confusable.diff: somehow 是「不知怎麼地、用某種方法」；anyhow 是「不管怎樣、無論如何」。

example.en: Somehow, the team finished the report before the deadline.
example.zh: 不知怎麼地，團隊在截止日前完成了報告。

similar.diff: 意思幾乎相同，但 anyway 更常見、可用於各種場合；anyhow 更口語。

example.en: The store was closed, so we ordered online anyway.
example.zh: 商店關門了，所以我們還是在網路上訂購。

similar.diff: 語氣較正式，適合用在書信、電子郵件或會議。

example.en: In any case, please send the invoice by Friday.
example.zh: 無論如何，請在星期五前寄出發票。

example.en: Sales are good; however, costs are rising quickly.
example.zh: 銷售很好；然而，成本正快速上升。

example.en: Some people were late, but the meeting started on time regardless.
example.zh: 有些人遲到了，但會議還是準時開始。

example.en: The price went up, but customers still buy the product.
example.zh: 價格上漲了，但顧客仍然購買這項產品。

senses.en: in spite of what has happened or what is true
senses.distinguish: 前面常有 but，表示「雖然有困難，還是要做」。

example.en: I know it is late, but I will call the client anyhow.
example.zh: 我知道很晚了，但我還是會打電話給客戶。

senses.en: used to go back to the main topic or to end a talk
senses.distinguish: 放在句首，用來轉換話題或收尾，後面常接逗號。

example.en: Anyhow, that is all for today, so thank you everyone.
example.zh: 總之，今天就到這裡，謝謝大家。

extra_vocab.en: a small dish you eat before the main meal
extra_vocab.note: 多益餐廳、飯店宴會與公司聚餐的情境很常見，常和 main course、dessert 一起出現。接待客戶時，點 appetizer 是常見的商務用餐流程。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: appetizer 是可數名詞，單數前要加 an（an appetizer），複數是 appetizers。

example.en: The restaurant offers six vegetarian appetizers on its lunch menu.
example.zh: 這間餐廳的午餐菜單上有六種素食開胃菜。

example.en: Let's order an appetizer while we wait for the client.
example.zh: 我們在等客戶的時候先點一道開胃菜吧。

example.en: The hotel will serve appetizers at the welcome reception.
example.zh: 飯店會在歡迎酒會上供應開胃菜。

example.en: The caterer prepared a large appetizer platter for the office party.
example.zh: 外燴業者為公司派對準備了一大盤開胃菜拼盤。

examples.en: We shared a shrimp appetizer before the main course arrived.
examples.zh: 主菜上桌前，我們分享了一道蝦子開胃菜。

examples.en: Guests enjoyed a small appetizer while waiting for the keynote speech.
examples.zh: 賓客在等待專題演講時享用了一道小開胃菜。

examples.en: The company dinner begins with an appetizer, followed by a main dish.
examples.zh: 公司晚宴以一道開胃菜開始，接著是主菜。

confusable.diff: appetizer 是「開胃菜」這道菜；appetite 是「食慾」。

example.en: The long hike gave everyone a big appetite for lunch.
example.zh: 長時間的健行讓大家午餐時胃口大開。

similar.diff: starter 是英式英語常用的說法，意思相同；美式英語較常說 appetizer。

example.en: For a starter, I will have the soup of the day.
example.zh: 開胃菜我要點今日例湯。

example.en: Most guests chose the fish entrée for the banquet.
example.zh: 大多數賓客在宴會上選擇了魚排主菜。

example.en: The set menu includes a drink and a dessert.
example.zh: 套餐包含一杯飲料和一份甜點。

example.en: Food and beverages will be provided at the reception.
example.zh: 酒會上會提供餐點與飲料。

example.en: The waiter handed each guest a copy of the menu.
example.zh: 服務生遞給每位客人一份菜單。

derived.link: 把 appetizer 的 -er 換成 -ing，變成形容詞「讓人想吃的」，像 interesting、exciting
